name: Reserve and send one generation three official neutralization mission without reusing event zero or one

condition.code: local p=Players[0]; local b=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary; return p and p:IsTurnActive() and b and type(b.ThirdSpyReserve)=='function'

steps.code: local b=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary; assert(b.ThirdSpyStatus().bound and b.RetryLivingSpy()=='MISSION_READY','third native spy must be at the original enemy Governor'); b.ThirdSpyReserve('SPY_MISSION'); return 'third mission reservation queued'

condition.code: local a=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary.thirdLast; if a=='ERROR_SPY_MISSION' then error(a) end; return a=='ACCEPTED_SPY_MISSION'
local a=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary.lastAction; if a=='ERROR_SPY_MISSION' or a=='REJECTED_SPY_MISSION' or a=='UNKNOWN_SPY_MISSION' then error(a) end; return a=='ACCEPTED_SPY_MISSION'
